水为什么能托住小船？: Why can water hold up a boat?
从一块木头、一团橡皮泥开始，亲眼看看水向上托的力。: Start with wood and clay. See the upward push of water.
先猜一猜，再放进水里: Make a guess, then try it in water
水的向上托力，叫作浮力。: The upward push of water is called buoyancy.
完全浸入后，还能继续向下移动。: Once fully underwater, you can keep moving it deeper.
水会从各个方向挤压物体。在静止的水中，同一个物体下方受到的压力通常比上方更大，合: Water pushes on an object from every direction. In still water, pressure is generally greater at its bottom than at its top. The combined result is an upward force.
浮力 = 排开的水的重量。漂浮稳定时，浮力和重力一样大。: Buoyancy equals the weight of displaced water. For an object floating at rest, buoyancy balances gravity.
这不是“轻的浮、重的沉”: There is more to it than being light or heavy
大船很重，但船壳围出很大的空间，可以在进水前排开很多水。小石头虽轻，却可能在完全: A large ship is heavy, but its hull encloses a large space and can displace a lot of water before it floods. A small stone can be lighter yet receive too little buoyancy even when fully immersed.
这是静止状态的教学场景，尺寸比例和水位变化适当夸张，体积以读数为准；不计算波浪、: This teaching scene shows settled states. Sizes and water-level changes are exaggerated; use the readings for volume. Waves, capsizing and surface tension are omitted. Seawater density is 1.025 g/mL. Clay does not absorb water; the boat stays upright and trapped air can escape after flooding.
压水实验里的方块由外部装置托住；箭头只显示浮力和重力。落到底部的物品，还会得到水: In the immersion experiment an external holder supports the block; arrows show only buoyancy and gravity. An object resting on the bottom also receives an upward support force from the tank floor.
沉下去了，也有浮力: It sinks, but buoyancy still acts
木块只要一部分进入水里，排开的水就已经足够重，能够把它托住。: Only part of the wood needs to enter the water to displace enough water for its weight to be supported.
水也在向上托它，只是这个力小于向下的重力。到达箱底后，箱底一起把它托住。: Water pushes it up, but with less force than gravity pulls it down. Once it reaches the bottom, the tank floor also supports it.
橡皮泥没有变轻！捏成船后，船壳围住的空间能让它在进水前排开更多水。: The clay has not become lighter! The space enclosed by the hull lets it displace more water before water can get in.
货物太多，水从船边流进来。空气能跑出去，船就不能再保持原来的排水空间了。: Too much cargo brings the rim down to the water. Water enters and air escapes, so the boat loses its enclosed displacement space.
进入水里的部分越多，排开的水越多，浮力也越大。: The more of the block enters the water, the more water it displaces and the greater the buoyancy.
现在方块全在水里。继续往深处移动，排开的水没有变多，浮力也基本不变。: The whole block is now underwater. Moving it deeper does not displace more water, so buoyancy stays essentially the same.
看看橡皮泥球和空心船：质量相同，结果却不同。: Compare the solid clay ball and the hollow boat: the same mass, different results.
给船加货物：船会更深地进入水里，直到排开的水足以托住新重量。: Add cargo: the boat sits lower and displaces more water to support the extra weight.
浸入水里的体积不变时，换成密度更大的水，浮力会更大。已经漂浮的物品会浮高一点，最: At the same immersed volume, denser water produces more buoyancy. A floating object sits a little higher and still ends with buoyancy equal to its weight.
旁边量杯展示与排水量相同体积的水，帮助比较；它不是从这个水箱另接出来的水。: The side measure shows an equivalent volume of displaced water for comparison; it is not water drained separately from this tank.
轻轻放入，看看它停在哪里。: Gently lower it and watch where it settles.
换个物品，或慢慢加一点货物。: Try another object, or slowly add some cargo.
数值表示停稳后的状态；短暂的移动和水纹帮助观察，不是物理时间模拟。: Readings describe the settled state. Brief movements and ripples help observation; they do not simulate physical timing.
进入水里的部分越多，水向上托的力越大。: The more of the block is in the water, the greater the upward force from the water.
已经全部进入水里，再往下压，水向上托的力基本不变。: Once the block is fully underwater, pushing it deeper hardly changes the upward force.
水从船边进来了，小船装不下这么多货物。: Water has come over the side. The little boat cannot carry this much cargo.
还是同一块橡皮泥。捏成空心船后，它能排开更多水。: It is still the same piece of clay. Shaping it into a hollow boat lets it displace more water.
水向上托着它。停稳时，向上和向下的力一样大。: Water supports it. When it floats at rest, the upward and downward forces are equal.
它沉下去了，但水仍然在向上托它。: It has sunk, but the water still pushes upward on it.
先捏成船，再一点点加货物，看看船边离水面还有多远。: Make a boat, then add cargo little by little. Watch the distance between its rim and the water.
慢慢往下压，比较半浸入和全浸入时向上的箭头。: Push down slowly. Compare the upward arrow when the block is half submerged and fully submerged.
换一个物品，先猜它会停在水面，还是箱底。: Choose another object. Guess whether it will stop at the surface or the bottom.

在船壳保持直立、内部不进水的模型中，漂浮要求总质量小于水密度乘以船沿没入前的最大: For an upright, watertight hull in this model, floating requires total mass to be less than water density times the maximum displacement volume before the rim submerges: m₍total₎ < ρ₍water₎V₍rim₎. At rest, actual displacement is m₍total₎/ρ₍water₎. Once the water reaches the rim and enters, the dry hollow hull calculation no longer applies.

四块货物不变：900 mL 窄船会进水；当前船沿容积 {{capacity}}: The four blocks stay the same: a 900 mL narrow hull floods. The current rim capacity is {{capacity}} mL and it is {{outcome}}.

浸深实验用悬线保持方块停稳。它比同体积的水重，绳始终绷紧；张力 T 加上浮力 F: A cord holds the immersion block at rest. It is heavier than the same volume of water, so the cord stays taut: tension T plus buoyancy F equals weight W. Lowering the fully immersed block hardly changes either upward force. Objects resting on the tank floor receive additional floor support. Force arrows share one scale and are offset for clarity.
悬线保持绷紧；每个位置都比较停稳后的受力。: The cord stays taut. Compare the settled forces at each position.
方块比同体积的水重，悬线始终绷紧。停稳时：水的托力 + 绳的拉力 = 向下的重力: The block is heavier than the same volume of water, so its cord stays taut. At rest: buoyancy + cord tension = weight.

越深的地方，水挤得越用力。整个方块再放低时，上下两边都增加了，差值没有增加，所以: Pressure is greater deeper down. Lowering the fully immersed block increases pressure at both top and bottom by the same amount. Their difference, and buoyancy, stay nearly unchanged.
水会向内挤压每一小块表面。左右同样深的地方相互抵消，下面比上面挤得更用力，合起来: Water presses inward on each small surface patch. Opposite sides at the same depth balance. Greater pressure below than above leaves an upward push.
先比较同一高度的左右箭头，再把悬线方块完全浸没，继续放低。: Compare left and right arrows at the same height. Then fully immerse the suspended block and lower it further.

水压剖面显示相对水面的表压 p − p₀ = ρgh。箭长表示局部压强，不是把所: The section shows gauge pressure relative to the surface: p − p₀ = ρgh. Blue arrow lengths encode local pressure; adding these drawn arrows does not yield force in newtons.
停稳静水模型；形状、剖面和水位变化为示意。量杯只作排水量对照，不从水箱取水；不计: Settled still-water model. Shapes, sections and water rise are illustrative. The measure compares displacement without taking water from the tank. Waves, capsizing and flooding rates are not solved.
水会垂直挤压物体表面。静止液体中，同深度处的压强相同；更深处的压强更大。上表面受: Water presses perpendicular to the surface. In a resting uniform liquid, pressure is equal at equal depths and increases downward. Pressure acts downward on the top, upward more strongly on the bottom, and opposing horizontal contributions cancel, leaving upward buoyancy.
剖面沿用同一物体、载荷、液体与浸深。蓝色局部箭头按表面法线向内，随相对水面的深度: The section retains the same object, cargo, liquid and immersion. Blue arrows act normally inward and grow with depth below the surface; the green resultant comes from the displacement model. Lengths and areas are uncalibrated, so the blue arrows cannot be numerically integrated. For objects at the floor, water is assumed to reach beneath them; changes caused by sealed contact are not modeled.

水为什么能托住它？跟着这三步，看水怎样推、这里原来装着什么，再比较被排开那份水的: Why can water support it? Follow three steps: see how water pushes, imagine the water that was here, then compare its weight.
水有重量。越往下，上面压着的水越多，水就挤得越用力。它从四周推物体，下方的向上作: Water has weight. Deeper down, more water presses from above, so the pressure is greater. Water pushes on every side. The stronger upward push from below leaves an upward force.
想象把物体占住的水下空间，换回同样多的水。这块水原来能安静地待在这里，是因为周围: Imagine filling the occupied underwater space with water again. That water could rest here because the surrounding water supported its weight. With the object in its place, the same upward support remains.
物体占了原来属于水的空间，水就让开，水面升高了，并没有新生出一份水。排开那份水有: The object takes up space where water was. Water moves aside and its surface rises; no new water is made. The weight of that displaced water tells us the size of the upward force.
虚线里是想象换回的水，物体没有真的变成水；只算原来在水面以下、被占住的空间。: The dashed outline imagines water put back. The object has not turned into water. Only occupied space below the surface counts.
对照杯里的 {{volume}} mL 水，质量约 {{mass}} g。它不在: The comparison cup shows {{volume}} mL of water, with a mass of about {{mass}} g. This cup does not push the object; the water touching the object does.
蓝色短箭头看每一处怎样挤，绿色箭头看合起来的向上托力。剖面是帮助看清方向的示意。: Blue arrows show local pushes; green shows their net upward force. This simplified section makes the directions easier to see.
停稳后，向上的托力刚好抵住它的重量。沉下去的东西也会受到水的托力。: At rest, the upward support balances its weight. Objects that sink also feel an upward push from water.
下沉也有浮力，只是水的托力还不够抵住它的重量。: Sinking objects also feel buoyancy; the upward push is too small to balance their weight.
想象：把这里换回水: Imagine water back in this space
船里进水后，那些已经装着水的空间不再算排水；只数泥和货物占住的部分。: Once the boat floods, spaces now filled with water no longer count as displaced water. Count the clay and cargo instead.
船壳把水挡在外面，所以水面下被挡住的空腔也要算。水面和接触边界没变，周围水的挤压: The hull keeps water out, so its dry space below the waterline counts too. With the same surface level and contact boundary, the surrounding water pushes in the same way.
这是想象替换，物体没有变成水。水面和接触边界没变，周围水的挤压就相同。: This is an imagined replacement, not a real change into water. With the same surface level and contact boundary, the surrounding water pushes in the same way.
水和绳子一起托住方块；放低时观察水的托力怎样增加、绳子怎样少出力。: Water and the cord support the block together. As more enters the water, the water supports more and the cord pulls less.
现在方块还没有进入水里，没有占住水下空间，也就没有排开水。先缓缓放低，再看水怎样: The block has not entered the water yet. It occupies no underwater space and displaces no water. Lower it gently to see how water begins to push.
此时水的浮力为零，是绳子托住方块。: The buoyant force is zero here; the cord supports the block.
从接触处，看水怎样推: How water pushes at the surface
水看起来安静，里面的分子一直在运动，也相互作用，把力传给邻居和物体。许多微小作用: Water may look still, but its molecules keep moving and interacting, exerting forces on their neighbours and the object. Many tiny interactions together produce water pressure.
水会从四面八方推物体。越深的地方，水的平均挤压越强；下方往上推，比上方往下推更有: Water pushes on an object from all sides. The average pressure is stronger deeper down. The upward push from below is stronger than the downward push from above, leaving an upward buoyant force.
想象把物体拿掉，用水填满它占住的水下空间。这份水能停在这里，是因为周围的水托住了: Imagine removing the object and filling the underwater space it occupied with water. This water could stay here because the surrounding water supports its weight. Put the object back, and the surrounding water still pushes in the same way.
放进物体，原来的水被挤开，水面升高。没有新生出水；我们把让开的那份水叫作“排开的: Putting an object in moves the existing water aside and raises the surface. No new water is made. We call the water moved aside the displaced water. Its weight equals the buoyant force.
放大同一物体的 A、B 接触处。水有重量，深处需要更大的平均挤压来保持平衡；不是: Zoom into contact points A and B on the same object. Water has weight, so greater average pressure is needed deeper down to keep it in balance. The molecules below are not moving faster.
先比较左右，再比较上下。蓝色箭头看各处水压，绿色箭头看合起来的浮力。水自身的重量: Compare left and right, then above and below. Blue arrows show local water pressure; green shows the combined buoyant force. Water’s own weight makes pressure greater at depth.
继续放低，上下两处的平均挤压都增加，但差值基本不变。这里保持相同水温，不把深处画: Lower it further: the average pressure above and below both increase, but their difference stays almost unchanged. The water temperature stays the same; molecules are not shown moving faster at depth.
水会向内挤压每一小块表面。把各处作用合起来，水平方向的作用抵消，留下向上的浮力。: Water pushes inward on each small surface patch. Add the effects over the whole object: the horizontal forces cancel, leaving upward buoyancy.
放大以后，水怎样施力？: How does water exert force up close?
液态水的分子彼此接近，持续运动并相互作用；大量微观作用在时间和空间上的平均，表现: Liquid-water molecules are close together, continually moving and interacting. Averaging many microscopic interactions over time and space gives macroscopic pressure. Liquid water cannot be explained only as widely spaced gas particles flying freely and bouncing off walls.
这里保持相同水温，水的密度近似均匀。压差来自水的重力与压力梯度平衡，不是深处的分: The water temperature stays the same and its density is approximately uniform. The pressure difference balances the water’s weight; it does not mean molecules are visibly faster or more crowded at depth. The enlarged views compare equal surface areas. Their arrows highlight the extra pressure due to depth, omitting the common atmospheric pressure.
分子小点、近邻连线和运动轨迹只作定性示意，大小、间距和时间均未按实测比例绘制；画: Molecular dots, neighbour links and motion paths are qualitative illustrations. Their size, spacing and time are not drawn to measured scale, and this is not a molecular-dynamics calculation. The observation animation stops after a short interval; still water does not mean real molecules stop moving.

试着逐块加货，再回到“水托住水”看看船下那份水。: Add cargo one block at a time. Then return to “Water supports water” to inspect the water beneath the boat.
进水的小船，哪些地方还在排水？: Which parts of a flooded boat still displace water?
已经装着水的空腔不再算排水。这里只比较金属和货物真正占住的水下空间。: The flooded cavity no longer counts as displaced water. Here we compare only the underwater space actually occupied by steel and cargo.
先减少货物，可再观察保持干燥的船舱。: Remove some cargo to observe the dry interior again.
先看这里原来的一份水: Start with the water already here
我们只在水里圈出一个形状。这份水能停在这里，因为周围的水正好托住了它的重量。: We only mark an imagined shape in the water. This parcel can stay here because the surrounding water supports exactly its weight.
轮廓是想象画的，没有薄膜，也没有额外的小容器。: The boundary is imagined. There is no membrane or extra container.
在同一个位置，换回物体: Put the object in the same place
水位和接触边界没变，周围水的托力也没变；换了的是里面东西的重量。: The water level and contact boundary stay the same, so the surrounding water provides the same support. What changes is the weight inside that boundary.
看清两种力：周围的水向上托，里面的东西向下重。: Compare the two forces: surrounding water supports upward, while the contents have weight downward.
放开以后，比较谁更重: Release it and compare the weights
物体比同形的水重，就往下走；比同形的水轻，就往上走。水一直在托着它。: If the object weighs more than the water in the same space, it moves down; if it weighs less, it moves up. Water keeps supporting it.
漂浮时，露出水面的部分增加，排水量随之减少，直到两种力平衡。: As it rises to float, more emerges above the surface and displacement decreases, until the two forces balance.
先猜一猜，再让它轻轻进入水里。可以随时停下来，看看水面上下的部分。: Make a guess, then lower it gently into the water. Pause anywhere to inspect the parts above and below the surface.
这些物体分别取景，画面大小不代表真实尺寸一样大。: Each object is framed separately. Similar sizes on screen do not mean equal sizes in real life.
进入水里的部分会把水让开。下沉和上浮的过程中，水都在向上托。: The part entering the water moves water aside. Water supports it upward whether it sinks or rises.
下一段把这个空间换回水，就能看清托力有多大。: Next, imagine water in this same space to find out how much upward support it provides.
停稳时，水向上托的力，正好抵住物体向下的重量。: At floating equilibrium, the upward force from water exactly balances the object’s downward weight.
继续看“水托住水”：这里原来那份水有多重？: Continue to “Water supports water”: how much did the water in this space weigh?
沉到底，也一直有浮力: Buoyancy remains, even at the bottom
水的托力还不够抵住它的重量。碰到底部后，底面再一起托住它。: Water alone cannot support its full weight. After it reaches the bottom, the lake bed provides the remaining support.
下沉不等于没有浮力。下一段比较物体与同形水的重量。: Sinking does not mean there is no buoyancy. Next, compare the object’s weight with water in the same space.
从水托住水，看到同一份金属变成船。: From water supporting water to the same steel becoming a boat.
同一物体在水中的位置和受力: Position and forces of the same object in water
三维画面暂不可用，正在显示同一过程的剖面示意。: The 3D view is unavailable. A cutaway illustrates the same journey.
观察整体或接触处: Observe the whole object or a contact point
回到本段开头: Return to the start of this chapter
切换液体后，仍观察同一个物体。海水密度稍大，同样的排水体积能提供稍大的托力。: Changing the liquid keeps the same object. Seawater is slightly denser, so the same displaced volume provides slightly more upward support.
为什么是同形水的重量？: Why the weight of water in the same space?
静水中，一份水能留在原位，是因为周围水的压力合力托住了它的重量。把它替换成具有相: A parcel can remain at rest in still water because the resultant of the surrounding water’s pressure supports its weight. Replace it with an object that has the same contact boundary, keeping the water level unchanged, and the surrounding pressure forces remain the same.
真正施力的是接触物体的水。排水没有制造新水，也没有额外的水在远处推物体。: The water touching the object exerts the force. Displacement creates no new water, and no separate parcel pushes the object from a distance.
金属质量 780 克，实体体积 100 毫升。金属成形的闭合网格保持材料体积；船: The steel has a mass of 780 g and a solid volume of 100 mL. Its closed forming mesh preserves material volume; the outer envelope below the rim and the displacement calculation use the same profile. Each cargo block has a mass of 100 g and a volume of 40 mL. Once flooded, the water-filled cavity no longer counts as displacement.
水体近似均匀、静止。位置、时间与成形为教学示意，不求解流体动力学、金属塑性、翻船: The water is approximately uniform and at rest. Position, time and forming are teaching illustrations; the model does not solve fluid dynamics, steel plasticity, capsizing or flooding rates. Each object is framed separately, rather than at equal real sizes. At lake-bed contact, water is assumed to reach beneath the object.
水压在各处垂直作用于表面，深处压强较大。完全浸没的刚性物体在均匀水中继续下移时，: Water pressure acts perpendicular to each surface patch and increases with depth. Moving a rigid, fully immersed object deeper in uniform water leaves its displaced volume and net buoyancy nearly unchanged.
液体分子持续运动并相互作用。微观图保持相同水温与近似相同密度；更深处的平均压强更: Liquid molecules keep moving and interacting. The close-ups keep the same water temperature and approximately the same density. Greater average pressure at depth does not mean molecules are visibly faster or more crowded. Sizes, paths and time are qualitative illustrations, without molecular-dynamics calculations. Pausing the short animation does not mean real molecules stop.
先看周围的水怎样推这份水: First see how surrounding water pushes this parcel
观察的位置没有改变。回到“水托住水”，换回物体后，再放大物体与水的接触处。: The position has not changed. Return to “Water supports water” and replace the parcel with the object before magnifying their contact.
换一种观察方法，不会提前推进替换过程。: Changing the view does not advance the replacement.
一样重，就这样浮住了: Equal weights: the boat stays afloat
这只船和同形水一样重。换回船再放开，向上的托力仍正好抵住它的重量。: This boat weighs as much as the same-shaped water. Replace the water with the boat and release it: the upward support still balances its weight.
如果加上货物，船需要再多排开一些水。: Adding cargo means the boat must displace more water.
这里把加工过程放慢、简化，方便看清形状怎么变。: Forming is slowed and simplified so you can follow the changing shape.
金属始终重 780 克，材料本身体积始终是 100 毫升。改变的是船壳挡开水的空: The steel always has a mass of 780 g and a material volume of 100 mL. What changes is the space from which the hull keeps water out. Each cargo block is 100 g and 40 mL; after flooding, the water-filled cavity no longer counts as displacement.
